verification_method: sha256 of stored bytes compared to the entry's AXN0 kernel; the identifier is the expected hash, so verification is self-contained

custody.terms: Stored cores live in this archive's public version-controlled repository and are served without account, login, or expiry. Any change or removal appears as a dated commit; nothing is silently deleted.
custody.single_point_of_failure: One administrator, one code host, one serving platform. Durable against link rot, accidental overwrite and quiet editing; NOT durable against a platform decision — this archive was itself terminated elsewhere in June 2026. A registry entry is a record, not a promise of perpetual hosting.
custody.mirror_freely: Listed with hash and length in /resourcesync/resourcelist.xml and /data/symbolon-registry/MANIFEST.json, and checksummed in /SHA256SUMS.txt. Fetch, hash, compare — copying requires no permission and verification requires no trust in this archive. Independent custody means a copy held by someone who is not this archive's administrator, on a platform it does not use.
custody.depositor_holds: The depositor's own original plus the Seed A sidecar can prove the work anywhere, with or without this archive. That is the point of splitting the identifier in two.

note: The registry witnesses the tuple and its internal consistency (glyphs recomputed from hashes at ingest). Seed B was not seen; verification against bytes is a separate act per SPEC §9.
position_note: The hex position is a registry address allocated from the shared AXN sequence (data/symbolon-registry/allocation.json). An address is not a verification.

axn0.role: identity kernel of the sealed core (the original, pre-stamp bytes)

axn1.role: kernel of the ADDRESSED stamped copy (tamper witness; not a name)

stamp_geometry.strip_stamp: crop to original_px then compare pixels; byte-identical strip NOT possible for raster (re-encode); AXN₀ verification requires Seed B = the original file

seed_a.registration: kernel is authority-independent; registry witnessing via https://www.alexanarch.org/deposit/ or by sending this sidecar to the archive

witnessing: Stamped 2026-10-22 with the archive's own client-side stamp tool (mint/stamp/), run in session on the declared display derivative of EA-ACT-ANALOG-01 (#1407): data/attachments/AXN-0590/display-rot90ccw.jpg, a 90° counterclockwise rotation of master.jpg (SHA-256 ceb944f37e2792af990ac63fad3e277710549d09cbb2b2a8e89e38c74b5a93a8), as that deposit's PROVENANCE records. The entry is written as /api/register-symbolon writes one, in a commit, and lands by bundle.
